# DailyBread Shawarma

Vibrant, custom-crafted shawarma, grill, and local catering eatery based in Bokwaongo Junction, Buea, Cameroon.

## Main Services
- **Beef & Chicken Shawarma Customizer**: Online premium ingredient builder (Lebanese pita, overnight-marinaded beef, sweet hibiscus Zobo context).
- **Fast Delivery Dispatch**: Streamlined order templates routing straight to WhatsApp on +237 652 351 693.
- **Physical Dine-In & Event Catering**: Sit down or order corporate boards and party boxes in South West region Cameroon.

## Coordinates
- **Address**: Beside Bishop Store, Bokwaongo Junction, Buea, South West Region, Cameroon
- **Google Maps Link**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/e1wFCcqxSkREmRnY7
- **Hours**: Tuesday to Sunday, 1:00 PM to 10:30 PM (Mondays Closed).
